Bigg Boss 20 Announces 16 Contestants Including Mary Kom

The reality television show 'Bigg Boss 20' has revealed its lineup of 16 contestants. Among the participants announced are boxer Mary Kom, actor Aman Gandhi, and actress Mahhi Vij. The show is set to premiere soon, featuring a diverse group of individuals from various fields.
